records.name: Afghanistan
records.summary_text: Afghanistan under the Taliban — the nation's current ruling movement — is the most hostile environment on this map for a transgender person. A 2024 Morality Law obliges the regime's virtue police to prevent "homosexuality" and "lesbianism", including "even if with one's own spouse"; the ruling movement applies the death penalty for same-sex relations under its interpretation of Sharia; and documented practice against LGBTIQ people includes beatings, sexual violence in detention, forced confessions, and house-to-house searches. Transgender residents report living in hiding, in windowless roo

records.name: United Kingdom
records.summary_text: The United Kingdom has a documented, in-force rollback concentrated on facilities and detention that directly affects trans visitors. Bathroom and changing-room use is now directed by biological sex under the equality watchdog's statutory code — a daily, nationwide civil restriction (the only country above 0.55 in this dataset with a nationally-legislated bathroom restriction). Since the April 2025 Supreme Court ruling, two severe-when-triggered risks apply if arrested: police forces strip-search trans women according to biological sex (with male officers), and trans women are placed in men
